in superior, do you have to pay 1 for the card and then x for

Ian

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
angel wrote:
>
> in superior, do you have to pay 1 for the card and then x for
> additional strikes or is it just pay x for x addditional strikes?

The card costs 1 blood to play.

The effect of the superior is to allow you to burn X blood to gain
X additional strikes. You'd still have to pay the cost to play the
card, though.
